web_surfer.description: GAIA web research agent with live web lookup tools. It can search DuckDuckGo, fetch readable text from a known URL, search Wikipedia, search arXiv, and download a URL file to a temporary local path. Use it for public factual lookup, source verification, academic-paper lookup, webpage reading, and retrieving web-hosted files. It does not operate a browser UI and does not inspect GAIA local attachments directly.

skills.name: web_search
skills.description: Search DuckDuckGo for a query and return up to five result titles, URLs, and snippets.

skills.name: fetch_webpage
skills.description: Fetch a specific URL and extract readable page text for source verification.

skills.name: wiki_search
skills.description: Search Wikipedia and return up to two article summaries with source URLs.

skills.name: arxiv_search
skills.description: Search arXiv and return up to three paper abstracts with source URLs.

skills.name: download_file_from_url
skills.description: Download a file from a URL to a temporary local path and return that file path.

file_surfer.description: GAIA local attachment analysis agent. It reads files from the active GAIA workdir, resolving relative paths and common testbed prefixes automatically. It can extract text from PDF, DOCX, and PPTX files; summarize CSV and Excel sheets; OCR images; ask a vision-capable model about images; transcribe audio with local Whisper; and save text content to a temporary file. Use it when the answer is contained in a local document, spreadsheet, image, audio file, or other attachment.

skills.name: read_pdf
skills.description: Read a local PDF file and extract page text.

skills.name: read_docx
skills.description: Read a local DOCX file and extract paragraph text.

skills.name: read_pptx
skills.description: Read a local PPTX file and extract text from slides.

skills.name: analyze_csv_file
skills.description: Inspect a local CSV file and return shape, columns, sample rows, and summary statistics.

skills.name: analyze_excel_file
skills.description: Inspect a local Excel file or sheet and return shape, columns, sample rows, and summary statistics.

skills.name: extract_text_from_image
skills.description: Run OCR with pytesseract on a local image file and return extracted text.

skills.name: analyze_image_with_llm
skills.description: Ask a vision-capable Azure OpenAI model a question about a local image file.

skills.name: transcribe_audio
skills.description: Transcribe a local audio file using local Whisper and return the transcript text.

skills.name: save_and_read_file
skills.description: Save provided text content to a temporary local file and return the file path.

code_exec.description: GAIA coding and computation agent. It executes Python, Bash, SQL, C, or Java code with the active GAIA task workdir as the current working directory, and it has direct arithmetic tools for simple numeric operations. Use it for calculations, parsing or transforming local attachments, counting, algorithmic reasoning, and executable verification.

skills.name: execute_code_multilang
skills.description: Execute Python, Bash, SQL, C, or Java code and return stdout, stderr, and execution status.

skills.name: multiply
skills.description: Multiply two numbers.

skills.name: add
skills.description: Add two numbers.

skills.name: subtract
skills.description: Subtract one number from another.

skills.name: divide
skills.description: Divide one number by another and return infinity for division by zero.

skills.name: modulus
skills.description: Return the remainder of one number modulo another.

skills.name: power
skills.description: Raise a base number to an exponent.

skills.name: square_root
skills.description: Return the square root of a non-negative number.
